name: PayRewards
summary: Business bill-payment platform that lets you pay vendors, contractors and taxes by card, ACH, wire or paper check and earn PayRewards Points on every payment, with a fee that depends on the points tier you choose.
best_for: US small businesses that pay many vendor bills and want to put them on a credit card or earn travel points even when the vendor only takes ACH or a check
skip_if: you need payroll or loan repayments, you pay few large bills and would rather not pay a percentage fee, you are outside the US, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Every payment carries a percentage fee, 1.75% to 3.25% plus 2.9% on cards, so the points have to be worth more to you than the fee. The page itself says the points are worth up to 5.7 cents on the best redemptions, and less on gift cards and invoice credit. Payroll and loan repayments are not supported. We have not paid a bill through it, so delivery speed and support are unknown to us.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-16 on payrewards.com/pricing, US dollars) No subscription; sign-up is free. Each bill pays a platform and rewards fee: Core 1.75% per transaction with 1 point per $1, Plus 3.25% per transaction with 2 points per $1. Card payments add a 2.9% fee. Delivery fees are $16 per wire transfer and $5 per paper check. PayRewards wrote on 13 November 2026 that there is no transaction limit and that points expire after 18 months without earning activity. We have not paid a bill through it.

schema_offer.description: Core, percent fee per transaction (Core 1.75% with 1 point per $1; Plus 3.25% with 2 points per $1); card payments add 2.9%; wire $16, paper check $5; no subscription. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-16.
